newsitem.title: JAPAN: Aramco's Jan spot LPG awarded at mid $330s-traders.
newsitem.headline: Aramco's Jan spot LPG awarded at mid $330s-traders.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's state-owned oil firm Saudi Aramco awarded both propane and butane at around $335 per tonne in its second January tender to sell liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), Japanese traders said on Friday.
The levels compare with $349 per tonne for propane and $358 for butane in the first January tender, they said.

Spot LPG tenders by Saudi Aramco attract traders' attention as the company partly bases its contract prices on the result of its three monthly tenders as well as the the firm's own assessment of spot market trends.

Judging from the results of the two January tenders, Aramco is expected to set contract prices for January at $320 to $330 per tonne for both propane and butane, up from December's $310, traders said.
Prices for most LPG cargoes which originate east of the Suez Canal are linked to Aramco's contract prices.
